notes: 1276–1365: GHA4_CH16 (pp.399, 401, 403) area: core to the Fifth Cataract latitude, CONTESTED al-Maris north of 19.76°N to Aswan and CONTESTED Makuria–Alwa frontier band Fifth Cataract–Kabushiya (all APPROXIMATE), plus an Old Dongola marker (pp.403-404); end 1365 = Dunkula left in ruins (p.404). 1365–1500: no shape and no markers; the kings resided at al-Daw (p.404) but al-Daw (Gebel Adda) has no db/cities.json entry; Qasr Ibrim, Faras and Banganarti have no cite for this period. [يحتاج تحقق] 1365–1500: لا شكل ولا علامات في انتظار مصدر موثّق وإحداثيات.
